evidence.reason: `DIFF_OPTS` at line 105 leaves Git rename detection enabled. With `git log -p`, a content-identical rename can produce only rename metadata, so gitleaks scans no added text for the moved file and path-based exemptions can be evaded. Adding `--no-renames` to the template (and regenerating `.github/workflows/denylist.yml`) restores fail-closed scanning by emitting delete/add content. This is a routine correctness repair to existing intended denylist behavior, not a new requirement.
